## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Identify any live download or visual behavior that remains unverified.

## Review

- [ ] Inputs and evidence contain no credentials, private paths, or paid artwork.
- [ ] Commands and affected documentation match the change.
